<title level="1" right="Deity " pfs="Standard">[Dranngvit (The Debt Minder)](/Deities.aspx?ID=86)</title>

<row gap="medium">
<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

<traits>
<trait label="LN" url="/Rules.aspx?ID=95" />
</traits>

**Source** [Highhelm](/Sources.aspx?ID=204) pg. 118

Most dwarves consider the dour goddess Dranngvit to be a necessary evil, a harsh and acrimonious deity to whom one turns only when all other options have been exhausted. Dwarven legend holds that she was once betrothed to [Torag](/Deities.aspx?ID=18) and destined to become queen of the dwarven pantheon, only to be denied her promised throne when Torag fell in love with and chose [Folgrit](/Deities.aspx?ID=87) as his bride instead. Humiliated and embittered, Dranngvit withdrew from Forgeheart, the [Heavenly](/Planes.aspx?ID=17) domain of the dwarven gods, to dwell forever in self-imposed exile far from the rest of her pantheon with her great hound Hefnd as her sole companion.

<column gap="tiny">

**Category** [Dwarven Gods](/DeityCategories.aspx?ID=6)

**Edicts** Help reclaim just debts, seek appropriate vengeance against transgressions

**Anathema** Allow a slight to go unrecognized, avoid repaying a debt, force others into debts you know are unpayable

**Area of Concern**
debt, pursuit, vengeance

**Follower Alignments**
LN, LE

**Pantheons**
[Dwarven Pantheon](/Deities.aspx?ID=196)

</column>

**Divine Sanctification** can choose unholy

**Divine Skill** [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7)

**Domains** [Knowledge](/Domains.aspx?ID=17), [Might](/Domains.aspx?ID=20), [Travel](/Domains.aspx?ID=30), [Vigil](/Domains.aspx?ID=55)

**[Alternate Domains](/Rules.aspx?ID=802)** [Fate](/Domains.aspx?ID=12), [Truth](/Domains.aspx?ID=32)
